page: End-to-end type safety explanation and Eden library. Toy train set analogy for matching track pieces. Client and server connection type matching. Elysia provides e2e type safety without code generation. RPC-like connector Eden. Lightweight under 2KB. No code generation required. Type inference over code generation. Other frameworks: tRPC, Remix, SvelteKit, Nuxt, TS-Rest. Server type changes reflected on client instantly. Auto-completion and type enforcement. Questions: What is end-to-end type safety? Why is it important? How is it different from tRPC?

sections.manifest: Eden RPC-like client library. Type-safe server connection. No code generation. TypeScript type inference. Weighs less than 2KB. 2 modules: Eden Treaty (recommended) and Eden Fetch. End-to-end type safety. Auto-completion support. Type-safe unit tests. Questions: What is Eden? What modules does Eden have? How much does Eden weigh?

Eden Treaty recommended module. Object-like API. End-to-end type safety. Full-type support. Auto-completion. Error handling with type narrowing. Type-safe unit tests. example: api.nendoroid({ id: 1895 }).put(). Error and data destructuring. 2KB library. Questions: Should I use Eden Treaty? What are Eden Treaty features?

Eden Fetch alternative module. Fetch-like syntax. Type safety without code generation. edenFetch() function. /name/:name path. params, method, body properties. No WebSocket support. Fetch syntax preference. Questions: What is Eden Fetch? When should I use Fetch? Does Eden Fetch support WebSocket?
